content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Courses teachable

Platforms like Teachable and Stripe promise ease of use and integrated payment processing, but they come with significant limitations. Teachable restricts users to specific countries and charges high fees. Stripe, while popular, operates in only 46 of 195 countries, leaving many creators without access. In contrast, a sovereign commerce infrastructure like COREMERCH offers a complete stack that empowers creators with full ownership of their online store, instant cryptocurrency payment processing, and file delivery. This infrastructure enables creators to fully control their sales process without reliance on external entities.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Teachable and Stripe have clear geographic limitations, which can exclude a vast number of potential users. For instance, a PayPal account suspension can trap funds for up to 180 days without recourse, leaving creators vulnerable. In contrast, a sovereign commerce setup allows creators in restricted countries to bypass these barriers entirely. With COREMERCH, creators can deploy their own online store infrastructure using tools like Cloudflare and NOWPayments, which are accessible regardless of geographic restrictions. This ensures that creators have the freedom and flexibility to manage their sales without the fear of platform limitations.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment processing, traditional platforms often impose high fees and long wait times. Stripe’s transaction fees can accumulate quickly, especially for small transactions, while PayPal may hold funds for extended periods. In contrast, with the COREMERCH infrastructure, creators benefit from a nominal 0.5% fee through NOWPayments for crypto transactions, which typically settle instantly on the blockchain. This not only reduces costs but also enhances cash flow, allowing creators to reinvest in their businesses without unnecessary delays.
Ownership means no more reliance on third-party platforms.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the most significant downsides of using platforms like Stripe and Teachable is the lack of ownership over your data and processes. Users must continuously rely on these platforms to host their courses and manage payments, which can lead to insecurity. With a sovereign commerce architecture, creators own their entire ecosystem post-deployment. This includes control over product delivery through robust automation via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring that users receive their purchases instantly without platform intermediation. This autonomy fosters trust and reliability in the business model.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Deciding between traditional platforms and a sovereign commerce infrastructure depends on your specific needs. If your country is excluded by major platforms, a solution like the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) becomes the obvious choice. It provides a fully configured deployment within 48 hours, allowing for scalability and ease of use. By leveraging Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase for backend management, creators can establish a professional online presence quickly and effectively, without the constraints imposed by conventional platforms.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Instant payments empower creators with immediate cash flow.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
